intent.user_request:
生成一条15秒、9:16竖屏的穿戴甲前后反差宣传视频。不要复制参考视频中的人物、服装、户外场景、首饰和文字，不生成旁白或额外字幕。

素材使用方式：
1. 商品图控制十枚甲片的款式集合，包括黑白花朵、琥珀黄色立体弧饰、白黑粉色几何、酒红白花朵和粉色立体花。佩戴锚点图只控制这些甲片安装到五指后的正确形态、朝向、长度和对应关系。
2. 参考视频是前后反差与手部展示姿势参考，不是连续安装教程。只继承“先展示自然手，再展示完成美甲”的结构、手靠近镜头的姿态和生活方式节奏；不继承其中任何人物身份、美甲款式、首饰、文字或具体背景。

分镜与状态：
- 0–3秒：第一镜只展示一只干净裸手，五指完整可见，没有甲片、指甲油或戒指。
- 3–4秒：用一次明确遮挡转场完成状态切换；不展示错误或半安装状态。
- 4–8秒：第二镜开始完整佩戴商品图对应的五枚甲片，手部形态以佩戴锚点图为准，缓慢翻转展示正面和侧面。
- 8–12秒：切换背景和手势，但同一套甲片持续存在，五指款式、长度和位置不能交换或消失。
- 12–15秒：微距英雄特写，五指扇形展开，重点展示立体花、金色珠饰和琥珀装饰，保持无文字结束。

状态约束：0–3秒必须裸手；4秒以后必须始终完整佩戴同一套甲片。切镜不能触发甲片消失、替换、换指或重新变成裸手。
intent.resolved_request: Generate a 15-second, 9:16 vertical before/after press-on nail promotional video: 0–3s shows one clean bare hand with all five fingers fully visible and no pieces, polish or rings; 3–4s is a single clear occlusion transition with no wrong or half-installed state; from 4–15s the same full five-piece set derived from the product image is worn per the worn anchor (form, orientation, length, finger mapping), with a slow front/side hand display, a background and gesture change at 8–12s that keeps the identical set intact, and a 12–15s text-free macro hero close-up of the fan-spread hand emphasizing 3D flowers, gold beads and amber decoration. Inherit from the reference video only the bare-hand-first-then-completed-manicure structure, hand-close-to-camera framing and lifestyle pacing; do not copy any person, clothing, outdoor scene, jewelry, text, specific background or reference manicure style, and generate no narration or extra subtitles.

scope: style groups: black-and-white floral, amber-yellow 3D arc ornaments, white-black-pink geometric, wine-red-white floral, pink 3D floral
per-piece colors, patterns and decorative elements

directives.target: correct worn state of the set on five fingers
before-after contrast structure, hand-display framing and lifestyle pacing
scope: bare natural hand first, then completed manicure
same full five-piece set always present
styles, lengths and finger positions unchanged
no piece disappearance, replacement or finger swap
never reverts to bare hand after 4s
emphasis on 3D flowers, gold beads and amber decoration

assumptions: IR completion: gold beads are evidenced on all ten pieces of the authoritative product image (visible, confidence 0.91–0.95, as central element or tip accent), so the 12–15s emphasis on gold beads is grounded in the product asset and requires no user confirmation.

IR completion: the occlusion transition is executed conservatively as the bare hand moving toward the lens until the frame is fully covered, then receding to reveal the completed set; this satisfies the single explicit occlusion transition and shows no wrong or half-installed state.

IR completion: the worn set uses one piece of each of the five style groups (black-and-white floral, amber-yellow 3D arc, white-black-pink geometric, wine-red-white floral, pink 3D floral) assigned to the five fingers following the worn anchor's positional layout, because the user locked five worn pieces and the anchor controls mapping rather than style.

IR completion: backgrounds are clean, neutral studio environments (soft plain backdrops) with no identifiable real-world location, consistent with the exclusion of the reference's outdoor scenes and specific backgrounds.
IR completion: shots frame only the hand with minimal wrist/forearm; no face, torso, outfit, or person identity is shown, consistent with the hand-display scope and the reference identity exclusion.
IR completion: no text overlays, captions, or subtitles appear at any point, conservatively extending the text-free ending (d_9) and the no-subtitles exclusion (d_11).
IR completion: soft studio lighting is used throughout so the glossy finish, gold beads, and 3D ornaments remain readable in every shot.
uncertainties: The worn anchor's perceived per-finger styles (e.g., 'white base with pink heart', 'dark brown base with white floral') differ in detail from the product image styles; per the user's explicit role separation, the product image is authoritative for style and the anchor only for worn form, orientation, length, and mapping, so the worn styles follow the product image.
The exact mapping of the five style groups to specific fingers is inferred conservatively from the worn anchor's positional layout because the user did not name finger-by-finger styles.

The exact occlusion technique at 3–4s is unspecified; the conservative hand-occlusion execution is an IR completion and may be replaced by any other single explicit occlusion that shows no wrong or half-installed state.
